title: Unit Event — Aim Higher and Higher! — Episode7 The World

meta.Event Outline: The day of Taiga and Ken's event has finally arrived. The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD are looking forward to this world-class event, when an incident leads to an unexpected reunion.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow...!
That was the first heavy metal performance I'd ever seen!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It was my first time hearing screamo...
It felt like my insides were getting physically shaken around.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was a pretty incredible performance. Was that it for the metal bands?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Yeah. Which means it's finally time for the street teams.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, there's a team taking the stage now!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
“Nice! They're up first!
They're gonna blow the roof off this place!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, everybody's going wild... But they just took the stage!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Hey, it's Ash Dust!
This is gonna be so good!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. I've only ever seen videos...

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: “All of you! Let me hear your voices!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(This power...
This is nothing like watching a video!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's like their voices are reaching right into my chest to grab my heart.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This energy is incredible... The bass rolls unstoppably over and through you.)

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
I knew they'd be awesome!
They've definitely leveled up since their last event!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: And the new song they just performed felt really different from their usual stuff.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
“Hey, you guys can do better than that!
Let me hear your voices!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa!
The crowd's singing the chorus, and they're singing it back...!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: It's a knock-down, drag-out fight between artist and audience.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Haha!
Who wouldn't be excited by this?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The rumbling hasn't stopped for even a second.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This venue's so big, but I can hear the music so clearly...)

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: “Thanks for being such a great crowd!”

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Wow...
That team was totally off the hook...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was shouting at the top of my lungs!

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: “I hope you guys all still have plenty of gas left in the tank! Because we have these guys up next!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...! It's Dad and Uncle Taiga...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What are they going to sound like?!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
“No, I've never heard of them.
But that one guy looks kinda familiar.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The venue's atmosphere changed the second they started singing...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (They don't sound anything like they did when they were RADder or singing solo...!)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
“We know you guys can still do better.
We're here to turn this into the hottest place on the planet.”

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
“So, stay with us until the end!!
You're not allowed to collapse or run out of gas!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Wait, they kicked it up even higher?!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The way they're singing... The energy in this venue... This is incredible...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I've never seen them perform like this!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Everybody in this venue has become one...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And we're all completely focused on the performance...!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “What a performance! This is absolutely awesome...!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “Haha... Never thought I'd get to hear these two sing together again!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You'll visit new places and experience new things in the future, so I think it's okay for you to all figure things out as you go along.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And eventually, you'll find what “standing on top of the world” means to you.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I had trouble visualizing it until now.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What it actually means to “stand on top of the world”.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Singing for people from all over the world, bringing this heat and this energy to them...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And making their hearts race, just like this...!!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm so excited that I can't stay still...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's like they're making every fiber of my being shake...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Argh. My head's a total mess right now.
But...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is the “world” we've been talking about...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The very thing we want to achieve!)

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: “Those two really know how to sing!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, wanna go say hi to them?
Dad and Taiga said that they're still near the stage.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, we should go over...
After all, they're the ones who invited us over.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: To get to the stage, we have to leave the seating area and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This place is still shaking... From their singing and all the cheering...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And the heat hasn't dissipated. Everybody here is...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What do things look like from that stage...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want our songs to bring the same heat they did!)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, you guys. Long time no see.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You two seem good, Slade, Ceddy.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We heard that you guys ran into these two over in Japan, An. What are the odds?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We didn't know that you'd all be watching this event together. So, what did you guys think of today's festivities?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Every artist was amazing, but you two were on a completely different planet.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He's right! Everybody was so captivated by your singing. You had us all eating out of your hand...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've never even dreamed of sights like we saw tonight!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: What's all this? It's not like you kids to pay compliments.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, you guys were just that awesome...!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But I think you're popping the cork a little too soon.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Because we're going to put on an even better performance in the near future.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'm sure you guys have all heard of it.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We'll be performing at “Lasting ECHO Fest”, the biggest music festival in the world, hosted right here in the US.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We're going to step out onto that stage and set the whole place on fire.
